episode.descriptionJp: 「世界でいちばんのスクールアイドルになる」という花帆の宣言を受けた梢は、次の金沢市内でのイベントに向けて、花帆に猛特訓を課す。
episode.descriptionEn: After Kaho declares that she will "become the world's greatest school idol," Kozue assigns her intense training for the next event in Kanazawa City.

turns.textJp:
あたし……自分のせいで、いろんな人の期待を、裏切っちゃった……。
やっぱり、花咲くなんて、あたしにはムリなのかな……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
I... betrayed so many people's expectations because of my own mistake...
Maybe blooming really is impossible for me...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
나…… 내 탓에, 여러 사람의 기대를, 저버렸어…….
역시, 꽃을 피우는 건, 나한테는 무리인 걸까…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I… I let so many people down, all because I was so careless…  I should’ve known… there’s no way someone like me could blossom…

turns.textJp: ……ぜんぶ、だめにしちゃったよ……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: ...I ruined everything...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: ……전부, 망쳐버렸어…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: …I ruined everything…

turns.textJp: 花帆さん？

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text: Kaho-san?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text: 카호 씨?

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: Kaho-san?

turns.textJp: あ、さ、さやかちゃん。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: Ah, S-Sayaka-chan.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 아, 사, 사야카.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Ah, S-Sayaka-chan…

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 片手を顔の近くで握りしめる（右）

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 片手を顔の近くで握りしめる（右）

turns.textJp:
どうしたんですか、こんなところで。
ライブの準備があるはずじゃ？

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
What are you doing here?
Shouldn't you be preparing for the live show?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
왜 그러세요, 이런 곳에서.
라이브 준비가 있을 텐데요?

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: What are you doing out here? Shouldn’t you be preparing for your performance?

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 片手を顔の近くで握りしめる（右）

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 片手を顔の近くで握りしめる（右）

turns.textJp: ……花帆さん？

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text: ...Kaho-san?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text: ……카호 씨?

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: …Kaho-san?

turns.textJp: ……それが。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: ...Well.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: ……그게.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: …Well, you see…

turns.textJp:
そうですか……。
それは、大変でしたね……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
I see...
That must have been very difficult...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
그렇군요…….
그건, 큰일이었네요…….

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: I see… That sounds rough…

turns.textJp: うん……。ぜんぶ、あたしのせいで。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: Yeah... It was all my fault.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 응……. 전부, 내 탓에.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Yeah… It’s all my fault…

turns.textJp: そんな、言い方は……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text: Please do not say it that way...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text: 그런, 말씀은…….

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: You shouldn’t say things like that…

turns.textJp:
花帆さんは、今まであまり激しい運動をしてこなかったんですよね。
だったら、自分の限界を見誤ってしまうのだって、仕方ないことかと……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
Kaho-san, you had not done much intense exercise until now, correct?
In that case, I think it cannot be helped that you misjudged your own limits...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
카호 씨는, 지금까지 별로 격한 운동을 해오지 않으셨잖아요.
그렇다면, 자신의 한계를 잘못 판단하는 것도, 어쩔 수 없는 일이라고…….

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: You haven’t done rigorous exercise like this before, right? It’s not your fault for not recognizing your own limits…

turns.textJp:
仕方ないなんて、そんなの……
もうちょっとで、大事故になるかもしれなかったんだよ！？

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
It can't be helped? That's not...
It could have almost become a huge accident!?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
어쩔 수 없다니, 그런 게……
조금만 더 있었으면, 큰 사고가 날 뻔했단 말이야!?

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Not my fault!? Don’t you understand this could have been much worse!?

さやか.motionDescription: 腕を掴んでうつむく（正面）

turns.textJp: あたしなんかのせいで、梢センパイが……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: Because of someone like me, Kozue-senpai...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 나 같은 것 때문에, 코즈에 선배가…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: And because of me, Kozue-senpai…

さやか.name: さやか
さやか.motionDescription: 腕を掴んでうつむく（正面）

さやか.name: さやか
さやか.motionDescription: 腕を掴んでうつむく（正面）

turns.textJp:
……そうですね。でも、今回はならなかったんです。
だったら、次からは気をつけましょう。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
...Yes. But this time, it did not.
In that case, let us be careful from next time on.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
……그렇네요. 하지만, 이번에는 그렇게 되지 않았어요.
그렇다면, 다음부터는 조심하면 되죠.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: …I know. But it wasn’t something big this time. Now you know to be more careful next time.

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho

turns.textJp:
花帆さん、あんなに朝練も嫌がっていたのに。
どうしてそんなにがんばったんですか。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
Kaho-san, even though you hated morning practice so much,
why did you work so hard?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
카호 씨, 그렇게 아침 연습도 싫어했는데.
왜 그렇게 열심히 하셨어요.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: Kaho-san, why did you push through all that morning practice, even though you didn’t like doing it?

turns.textJp: それは……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: That's...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 그건…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Because…

turns.textJp:
スクールアイドルが楽しくて……
でも、それだけじゃなくて。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
Because being a school idol is fun...
But that wasn't all.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
스쿨 아이돌이 즐거워서……
하지만, 그것뿐만이 아니라.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Because I think being a school idol is fun… But, that’s not all.

turns.textJp: 最初は、ちょっとずつ上手になっていくことが、嬉しかったんだ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
At first, I was happy
that I was getting a little better bit by bit.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 처음에는, 조금씩 잘하게 되는 게, 기뻤어.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: When I was first starting to slowly improve, I was so happy.

turns.textJp:
あたしが一人前のスクールアイドルになったら、今度こそ、
応援してくれるみんなを笑顔にできるぞ、って思って……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
I thought, once I became a full-fledged school idol,
this time I could make everyone cheering me on smile...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
내가 한 명 분의 스쿨 아이돌이 되면, 이번에야말로,
응원해 주는 모두를 웃게 해줄 수 있을 거라고 생각해서…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I felt that when I became a full-fledged school idol, I could bring smiles to everyone supporting me for sure…

intraEvents.description: あごに両手を添えて期待する

花帆.motionDescription: あごに両手を添えて期待する

turns.textJp:
でも、梢センパイが、あたしのこといっぱい褒めてくれて……。
あたしと一緒に、夢だった衣装を着たいって言ってくれて。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
But Kozue-senpai praised me so much...
And she said she wanted to wear the costume she dreamed of with me.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
하지만, 코즈에 선배가, 나를 잔뜩 칭찬해 줘서…….
나랑 같이, 꿈이었던 의상을 입고 싶다고 말해줘서.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: But Kozue-senpai would compliment me so much… and she’d say how much she wanted to wear those beautiful outfits with me.

background.comment: 部室棟 部室 夕

花帆.motionDescription: あごに両手を添えて期待する

turns.textJp:
だからあたし、梢センパイの真剣な想いに、応えたいって思って……。
こんなんじゃぜんぜんだめだから、もっとがんばらないとって……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
So I wanted to answer Kozue-senpai's sincere feelings...
I thought I was nowhere near good enough like this, and I had to work harder...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
그래서 나, 코즈에 선배의 진지한 마음에, 보답하고 싶다고 생각해서…….
이래서는 전혀 안 되니까, 더 열심히 해야 한다고…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: So I wanted to meet those serious expectations… I thought that since I was no good at all, I just had to keep working harder…

turns.textJp: 花帆さん……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text: Kaho-san...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text: 카호 씨…….

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: Kaho-san…

turns.textJp: 花帆さんは、優しいですね。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text: You are kind, Kaho-san.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text: 카호 씨는, 상냥하네요.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: You’re so considerate, Kaho-san.

さやか.motionDescription: 顎に手を当てて首をかしげる（左）

さやか.name: さやか
さやか.motionDescription: 顎に手を当てて首をかしげる（左）

turns.textJp: そんなことない。あたしなんて、自分勝手で……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: I'm not. I'm selfish...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 그렇지 않아. 나 같은 건, 제멋대로고…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: No, I’m not. I’ve been so selfish and…

turns.textJp:
でも、自分が楽しむよりも、
乙宗先輩のためにがんばろうと思ったんですよね。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
But instead of enjoying yourself,
you tried to work hard for Otomune-senpai.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
하지만, 자신이 즐기는 것보다,
오토무네 선배를 위해 열심히 하려고 생각했잖아요.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: You weren’t working so hard for your own enjoyment, but because you were thinking of Otomune-senpai, right?

turns.textJp:
厳しい練習の上、自主練習までして。
誰にだって、できることじゃありません。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
You went through strict training, and even practiced on your own.
That is not something anyone can do.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
힘든 연습에 더해, 자율 연습까지 하고.
누구나, 할 수 있는 일이 아니에요.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: On top of that strict practice schedule, you decided to practice even more in your own time. Not everyone would do something like that.

turns.textJp: ……。でも結局、うまくできなかったよ……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: ...But in the end, I couldn't do it right...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: ……. 하지만 결국, 잘하지 못했어…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: …But in the end, I couldn’t get it right…

turns.textJp: いっぱい迷惑かけて、センパイにも、きっと、嫌われちゃった。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: I caused so much trouble, and Senpai probably hates me now.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 잔뜩 폐 끼치고, 선배한테도, 분명, 미움받았을 거야.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I caused so many problems… I’m sure Senpai hates me now…

turns.textJp:
……大丈夫ですよ。
乙宗先輩は、そんなことで花帆さんを嫌いになったり、しませんよ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
...It will be all right.
Otomune-senpai would not come to hate you over something like that.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
……괜찮아요.
오토무네 선배는, 그런 걸로 카호 씨를 미워하거나, 하지 않아요.

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka
en_idolst.text: …It’s okay, Kaho-san. And Otomune-senpai wouldn’t hate you for something like this.

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: うつむいて横に首を振る（速）

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: うつむいて横に首を振る（速）

turns.textJp:
……乙宗先輩が戻ってきたら、あとでしっかりとお話ししましょう。
今は少し、休みませんか。

en_hasuko.speaker: Sayaka
en_hasuko.text:
...When Otomune-senpai comes back, please talk with her properly later.
For now, why don't you rest a little?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 사야카
ko_hasuko.text:
……오토무네 선배가 돌아오면, 나중에 제대로 이야기 나눠보세요.
지금은 조금, 쉬지 않겠어요?

en_idolst.speaker: Sayaka

지금 기수까지 이어지고 있다면,

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Wait, if there are this many notebooks…

en_hasuko.text:

ko_hasuko.text:
이게 아니고, 이게 아니고…….

en_idolst.text: Not this one… or this one… Oh, here. This is the most recent School Idol Notebook.

turns.textJp:
梢センパイ、あたしのために、練習メニューを書いてくれてる……。
こんなに細かく……。なのに、あたしは勝手に……。

en_hasuko.text:

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: …Ah.

turns.textJp: これ……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: This...

en_hasuko.text:

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호&코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:

하지만, 보람 있고, 매우 즐겁다.
하루하루 성장해가는 그녀를 보는 것은, 내 일처럼 기쁘다』

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho & Kozue
en_idolst.text: “Mentoring a junior isn’t as easy as I’d expected. But, it has been satisfying and very fun. Seeing her improve little by little every day has brought me such happiness as if it were my own improvement.”

turns.textJp: 梢センパイの……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: Kozue-senpai's...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 코즈에 선배의…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: This is Kozue-senpai’s…

turns.textJp:
『できればずっと、スクールアイドルを続けてほしい。
つらいことや、傷つくこともいっぱいあるだろう。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho & Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
"If possible, I want her to continue being a school idol for a long time.
There will likely be many painful things, and many things that hurt her.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호&코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
『가능하다면 계속, 스쿨 아이돌을 이어갔으면 좋겠다.
괴로운 일이나, 상처받는 일도 잔뜩 있겠지.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: “If possible, I’d like her to continue being a school idol. There may be a lot of difficulty and pain ahead of her, though.

turns.textJp:
だけど、それを乗り越えた先には、きっと今まで以上に、
楽しいことが待っているはずだから』

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho & Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
But beyond overcoming them, surely there will be
even more fun waiting for her than before."

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호&코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
하지만, 그것을 극복한 끝에는, 분명 지금까지 이상으로,
즐거운 일이 기다리고 있을 테니까』

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: But as soon as she gets through it, I’m sure that even more fun than she’s having now will be awaiting her.”

turns.textJp:
『ひたむきにがんばっているあの子を見ると、
胸が熱くなる。こんな気持ちは初めてだ。
後輩がこんなに可愛いってことも、知らなかった』

en_hasuko.text:
"When I see that girl working earnestly,

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호&코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:

후배가 이렇게 귀엽다는 것도, 몰랐다』

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: “Seeing her work so earnestly makes me feel motivated too. I think this is the first time I’ve felt this way. I had no idea that our juniors could be this cute, either.”

turns.textJp: 『あの子のためなら、私はなんでもしてあげたいって思う』

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho & Kozue
en_hasuko.text: "For that girl's sake, I feel as if I would do anything."

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호&코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 『그 아이를 위해서라면, 나는 뭐든지 해주고 싶다고 생각한다』

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: “I think I would do anything for her.”

turns.textJp:
あたし……。このまま逃げてちゃ、本当にだめになっちゃう。
そんなの、やだ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
I... If I run away like this, things really will go wrong.
I don't want that.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
나……. 이대로 도망치면, 정말로 안 되게 돼버려.
그런 건, 싫어.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I… If I run away now, everything will really go to waste. I can’t let that happen.

turns.textJp:
センパイにしっかり謝って……、それから。
ちゃんと、言わなくっちゃ！

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
I have to apologize properly to Senpai... and then.
I have to say it clearly!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
선배한테 제대로 사과하고……, 그리고.
제대로, 말해야 해!
